name: Auto Hand-off
description: Automatic account switching for Orca agents. Pools the managed accounts per provider (Claude, Codex, Antigravity, OpenCode, Devin). Smart mode looks ahead: it leaves an account shortly before it runs out and resumes the session on the next account of that provider, so the model and the context never change. To reach panes outside the focused workspace it also runs the orca CLI (account select, terminal close/send).

settings.title: Auto hand-off Claude accounts
settings.description: Off: Claude panes are never switched or resumed automatically (manual switching still works).

settings.title: Auto hand-off Codex accounts
settings.description: Off: Codex panes are never switched or resumed automatically (manual switching still works).

settings.title: Auto hand-off Antigravity accounts
settings.description: Off: Antigravity panes are never switched or resumed automatically (manual switching still works).

settings.title: Auto hand-off OpenCode accounts
settings.description: Off: OpenCode panes are never switched or resumed automatically (manual switching still works).

settings.title: Auto hand-off Devin accounts
settings.description: Off: Devin panes are never switched or resumed automatically (manual switching still works).

settings.title: Auto-switch
settings.description: smart (recommended): looks ahead. It leaves an account shortly before it runs out, picks the next one by how long it will last, and uses weekly quota that is about to expire first. my-order: follows your account order (Account order below) and goes back to an earlier account when it is free again. manual: never switches by itself. custom: uses the Advanced settings below exactly as they are set. auto (default): smart, unless you had changed the Advanced settings in an earlier version; those are then kept (an account order gives my-order, strategy manual gives manual, anything else custom).

settings.title: Switch early
settings.description: When to leave an account that is running out. just-before: about 10 minutes before the limit at the current pace (or at 97 % of the 5-hour window, 99 % of the week, when the pace is unknown). earlier: about 25 minutes before (or at 90 % and 97 %). at-limit: only when the limit is reached. Not used when Auto-switch is custom.

settings.title: Running sessions
settings.description: move: a session moves to another account between turns or when it sits idle, never in the middle of a turn and never with unsent text in its input box. limit: a session moves only when it hits a limit. launches: running sessions are never moved; only new sessions start on another account. Not used when Auto-switch is custom.

settings.title: When everything is used up
settings.description: wait: the session waits for the first account to reset and then resumes by itself. stop: the session stops and you are told. Not used when Auto-switch is custom.

settings.title: Account order
settings.description: Your own order of accounts within each service, comma-separated: emails, seat keys (claude:<id>, codex:system) or provider:*. Example: me@example.com, claude:*. Empty = Orca's order. Switching never leaves the agent's own service.

settings.title: Never switch to
settings.description: Comma-separated accounts that automatic hand-off never picks (emails, seat keys, or provider:*). Picking them from the panel still works.

settings.title: First message after a switch
settings.description: Empty = resume silently.

settings.title: Retry on API errors
settings.description: Types the first message again after a Fibonacci backoff (5 s … 120 s).

settings.title: Model fallback
settings.description: Models to try on the same account when one model's limit is hit, e.g. claude=sonnet,haiku; codex=gpt-5-mini

settings.title: Default cooldown (minutes)
settings.description: Used when neither the message nor Orca says when a limit resets.

settings.title: Read usage from Orca every (seconds)
settings.description: How often the plugin reads Orca's usage numbers (15–3600). Orca itself refreshes the account in use about every 5 minutes while its window is open, and accounts not in use only when its usage view opens or right after an account switch, so a shorter period only picks those up sooner.

settings.title: Remember usage of accounts not in use for (hours)
settings.description: When Orca has no current numbers for an account, the plugin uses its last reading, shown with its age; windows whose reset time has passed count as reset. 0 = only Orca's current numbers.

settings.title: Orca CLI path
settings.description: Empty = detect (ORCA_CLI_COMMAND, the app bundle, then orca).

settings.title: Console status line header
settings.description: Optional line above the account rows of the console status line; empty = rows only. Placeholders: {model}, {ctxbar} context-left gauge, {ctx} context left %, {5h} and {7d} this pane's % left, {reset} time until the 5-hour window resets, {best} the best-model window's name. Example: {model} │ ctx {ctxbar} │ 5h reset {reset} │ best={best}

settings.title: Console status line bar width
settings.description: Cells per gauge. 8 keeps a row with three gauges and a cooldown inside 80 columns.

settings.title: Advanced: Strategy
settings.description: Only used when Auto-switch is custom. drain: stay on an account until it is limited, then take the next in chain order. balanced: the account with the most room. priority: always the first healthy account in the chain. soonest-reset: the account whose weekly window resets first, so expiring usage is spent first. manual: never switch automatically.

settings.title: Advanced: Switch back when a higher-priority account resets
settings.description: Only used when Auto-switch is custom. drain and priority only: once an account earlier in the chain is healthy again, new launches use it and sessions on lower accounts move back when they finish a turn (or sit idle, see below).

settings.title: Advanced: Minimum minutes between automatic selection changes
settings.description: Only used when Auto-switch is custom (otherwise 5). Applies to threshold, switch-back and idle moves, so two accounts near the line never ping-pong. Rate limits and auth failures ignore it.

settings.title: Advanced: Minimum headroom gap for a threshold move (%)
settings.description: Only used when Auto-switch is custom (otherwise 10). A threshold move needs a target with at least this many points more room than the current account (when both are known). An exhausted account may always leave.

settings.title: Advanced: Move idle sessions after (seconds)
settings.description: Only used when Auto-switch is custom (otherwise 900, see Running sessions). A session idle this long on an over-threshold account, or on a lower account while a higher-priority one is healthy, is moved. 0 = off. Sessions with unsent text in the input box are left alone.

settings.title: Advanced: Switch on rate limit
settings.description: Only used when Auto-switch is custom.

settings.title: Advanced: Switch at usage threshold
settings.description: Only used when Auto-switch is custom (see Running sessions). Checked when an agent finishes a turn.

settings.title: Advanced: 5-hour threshold (%)
settings.description: Only used when Auto-switch is custom; with Auto-switch on auto, a value below 100 is kept as a hard cap and selects Switch early: earlier. 100 = only when exhausted.

settings.title: Advanced: Weekly threshold (%)
settings.description: Only used when Auto-switch is custom; with Auto-switch on auto, a value below 100 is kept as a hard cap.

settings.title: Advanced: Resume the session after a switch
settings.description: Only used when Auto-switch is custom (see Running sessions).

settings.title: Advanced: Wait for reset when every account is exhausted
settings.description: Only used when Auto-switch is custom (see When everything is used up).
